plan.bias: bearish — continuous selling, sellers in control; fade with trend on gap-up, hunt seller SLs (buy) on flat/gap-down
plan.summary: The teacher sees continuous selling across NIFTY, BANKNIFTY and SENSEX with sellers firmly in control. On a flat or gap-down open he plans to hunt the trapped sellers' stop-losses by identifying buying-side (CE) setups; on a gap-up open he will flow with the trend and look for selling-side (PE) setups since seller SLs won't be available. Key levels: NIFTY R 22340/22420, S 22140/22000; BANKNIFTY R 55400/55000, S 54000/53700; SENSEX R 72220/71900, S 71000/70750.
